# Release Notes – Monitoring App v2.3

## New Features

- **GPU Dashboard**
  - Centralized view of all GPU servers.
  - Shows per‑GPU utilization, memory usage, temperature, driver & CUDA versions.
  - Quick filters for GPU model, utilization thresholds, and server location.
  - Exportable charts and CSV reports for performance analysis.

- **Faster Alarm Search**
  - Search performance improved by ~70% for large alarm datasets.
  - New indexing on alarm `status`, `severity`, and `timestamp` fields.
  - Real‑time suggestion dropdown while typing.
  - Supports advanced filters (e.g., `status:open AND severity:critical`).

## Bug Fixes

- **CSV Export Fix**
  - Resolved issue where exported CSV files omitted rows when the dataset exceeded {{int:400:600}} records.
  - Correct handling of special characters and line breaks in text fields.
  - Added consistent column ordering across all export types.

## Other Improvements

- Minor UI polish for the navigation sidebar.
- Updated documentation for the new GPU dashboard.
- Backend dependencies upgraded to improve overall stability.

---
For a full list of changes, see the [GitHub release page](#).
